04

Reading Comprehension

Đọc đoạn văn ngắn về bạn Phong và trả lời 8 câu hỏi (Q31 - Q38).

📖 Reading Text: Phong's New School

"My name is Phong. I am in grade 6 at An Son Secondary School. My school is big and clean. There are 20 classrooms and a large playground. My favorite subject is English because I want to talk to international friends. Every morning, I get up at 6:00, have breakfast, and walk to school with my neighbor Minh. At school, we have five periods every day. During break time, I often read books in the library or chat with my friends. After school, I go home and do my homework. I love my school very much."

💡 Key Knowledge Summary (Tóm tắt kiến thức cốt lõi Unit 1)

• Hiện tại đơn (Present Simple): Diễn tả thói quen (S + V(s/es)). Ví dụ: She studies English.

• Hiện tại tiếp diễn (Present Continuous): S + am/is/are + V-ing (hành động đang diễn ra). Ví dụ: They are playing.

• Phương tiện giao thông: Dùng giới từ by + vehicle (by bike, by bus). Ngoại lệ: on foot.
